name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2598: REG-579. swallow_ratchet was red at 78 vs baseline 74 and could say only 4 NEW site(s) - the baseline stored ONE integer, so a red carried no file, no direction, nothing to act on. The cheap way to clear it was --write-baseline, which ADOPTS the new sites - the same shape REG-568 found in the render ratchet one file over. The baseline now records rank1 per FILE (per file not per line, because a line moves on every ordinary edit), a red NAMES where it rose and where it fell, and a baseline predating the map reports WHICH FILES IS UNKNOWN rather than no file rose. Then I used it - diffed against the commit that wrote the baseline and named all four - board_sync ledger_highwater reel_demo and control_app do_GET. Fixed all four rather than re-baselining - 78 to 74, exactly the baseline, nothing adopted. reel_demo and the control_app one were MINE. ledger_highwater was the worst - seed WRITES the peaks file back so an unreadable read became an EMPTY one and every peak reset to today, defeating this modules own SEEDING MAY ONLY RAISE rule.
